feature: Inline whiteboard: size panel open while the canvas zooms by wheel (panel straying from its anchor, counted in frames)
scale: 2 nodes, 1 editor, 16 wheel ticks (8 out, 8 in) 35 ms apart; the repository real AI shot (640x360), not the 4K library clip; frames where the panel is more than 2 px from where its anchor puts it
budgetBasis: Regression guard for removing per-frame polling: the polling implementation and the IntersectionObserver-only one both measured 12 of ~230 frames off; 20 is about 8% of frames, tolerating machine noise.

baseline.machine: win32 x64 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-13900H x20 / 64GB
